{{confuse|Clue box|Scroll case}}
[[File:Scroll box (beginner) detail.png|150px|thumb|right|A beginner scroll box.]]
'''Scroll boxes''' are a stackable variant of [[clue scroll]]s, in which opening them will give players a clue scroll of the same tier. However, they '''do not''' share the one hour despawn timer that clue scrolls have, instead possessing the normal despawn timer of three minutes. If a clue scroll is already in the player's inventory or bank, players will receive the message, {{mes|The clue box refuses to open - you already have a clue.}}

Upon completion of [[X Marks the Spot]], scroll boxes are obtained in place of clue scrolls, and are stackable up to a certain limit depending on the number of clue completions; this cap, which includes scrolls and scroll boxes, starts at 2 for each clue tier, and can be increased to a maximum of 5 by opening the following [[scroll case]]s:
* Minor scroll case - increases the stack limit of scroll boxes by 1 for a specific tier.
* Major scroll case - increases the stack limit of scroll boxes by 1 for a specific tier (for a total of +2 with the minor case).
* [[Mimic scroll case]] - rewarded upon defeating [[the Mimic]], and increases the stack limit of scroll boxes by 1 '''for all tiers.'''

Your current scroll box capacity can be checked at a [[Treasure Trail Statistics]] board. 

Players who completed enough clue scrolls to be eligible for a case prior to [[Update:Stackable Clues are here!|the 2 July 2025 update]] that added scroll cases will have the cases in question be automatically opened and added to their [[collection log]].

If players reach their current cap and successfully roll for a scroll box, a game message in the chatbox will state {{mes|You have a sneaking suspicion that you would have received a [tier] scroll box.}}

Scroll boxes combine when dropped on the same tile. If a player tries to pick up a stack of scroll boxes with more than their allotted capacity, a message in the chatbox will state {{mes|One of your scroll boxes was destroyed as you have too many of that tier.}} or {{mes|Some of your scroll boxes were destroyed as you have too many of that tier.}} depending on how many scroll boxes were destroyed. This also happens if a player tries to use telegrab to get more scroll boxes.

If a player tries to pick another scroll box whilst at max capacity, a message will state {{mes|You can't take any more of that tier of scroll box.}}

Scroll boxes can also be obtained in [[Deadman Mode]] when a [[stockpiling charm]] is in the player's inventory.

There are six types of scroll box:
*{{plink|Scroll box (beginner)}}
*{{plink|Scroll box (easy)}}
*{{plink|Scroll box (medium)}}
*{{plink|Scroll box (hard)}}
*{{plink|Scroll box (elite)}}
*{{plink|Scroll box (master)}}

==Trivia==
* For players who are [[clue juggling]], opening a scroll box when you have a clue scroll of the same tier on the ground with some number of completed steps will reset those completed steps to 0. 
* Scroll boxes were first featured during [[Leagues]]; during the [[Twisted League|Twisted]] and [[Trailblazer League (2020)|Trailblazer Leagues]], players needed [[Treasure Seeker (Twisted League)|Treasure Seeker]] in order to obtain scroll boxes; however, since [[Shattered Relics League|Shattered Relics]], it is a passive given to all players.
